findings.current: Nor was he a Young Hero.
findings.reason: Taekyung is contrasting his brother’s former standing with his new status, not addressing him; repeating Jin Wikyung’s name here would make the contrast nonsensical.
findings.replacement: Nor was he merely a young martial artist.
findings.speaker: Jin Taekyung, narrating

summary: One third-person use should change because “Young Hero” is not an address here.
